error[ZBX-E0219]: bad value for a logs option
  cause  'many' is not a whole number of lines from 0 to 1000000
  fix    give a number of lines:   zbx logs --tail 20 web
  more   zbx explain E0219 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0219.html
